key.name: master-enabled
key.description: Master enable or disable toggle switch for Antigravity KeepAwake

key.name: mode
key.description: 0: Auto (follows Antigravity activity), 1: Always Keep Awake, 2: Disabled

key.name: grace-period-seconds
key.description: Countdown in seconds after Antigravity finishes task before allowing sleep

key.name: audio-chime-enabled
key.description: Play a subtle chime sound when Antigravity finishes a task

key.name: target-apps
key.description: Process names targeted for SIGSTOP when laptop lid is closed
